how.listen.title: Listens to your Mac
how.listen.text: Lingora hears whatever plays on your Mac: a video, a class, a podcast. No audio sources to set up.
how.translate.title: Translates as they speak
how.translate.text: It understands what is said and translates it into your language sentence by sentence, almost instantly.
how.read.title: Read it or hear it
how.read.text: Captions in the app or floating over the video, even in full screen. If you like, a voice says it translated.
how.local.title: All on your Mac
how.local.text: Nothing leaves your computer. Once downloaded, it works offline.
permissionText: The first time you start, macOS will ask for permission to record system audio. Lingora only uses it to translate what is playing and never sends it anywhere.
leadDone: Lingora already has everything it needs.
leadDownload: Lingora will download the components it uses to listen, translate and speak: {size} to download. This only happens once.
status: {percent} %{eta}. You can close Lingora: next time it will pick up where it left off.
explainDownload: Starts now. If you close Lingora midway, next time it will pick up where it left off.
explainNoVoice: You enter Lingora with captions. You can download the voice later from the app's diagnostics.
explainSkip: You enter Lingora without downloading. You can do it later from the app's diagnostics; until then you won't be able to translate.
